boundaries: A Principal Reference contains only the minimum stable identifier, kind, issuer or registry, resolution route, and integrity data needed by the consumer.
The referenced Principal remains the identity authority; the reference cannot copy, mutate, authenticate, or replace it.
A Principal Reference contains no reusable credential and proves no Person identity, Role, Assignment, or authority grant.
claim_ceiling: This candidate defines Principal Reference for review only. It does not admit the Definition or any carrier, instance, relation, Policy, Decision, runtime behavior, authority, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
residue_refs: Definition-owner review and exact admission remain required.
Artifact Type carrier, relation, qualifier, ontology, runtime, and consumer decisions remain separate.

notation.meaning: One subject evaluated under the Principal Reference Definition.

testable_conditions: Every Principal Reference resolves to exactly one governed Principal or becomes explicitly unresolved.
No secret, credential, or excess identity data is embedded.
Every authority decision resolves separate current grant evidence rather than inferring it from the reference.
